clips.title: The story
paras: Ban'ethil Hollow is a rugged ravine cutting into the woodland just south of the main road connecting Dolanaar and Darnassus. It has become a dangerous haven for corrupted, aggressive furbolgs who pose a constant threat to travelers. Tucked away in the back of the ravine lies the entrance to the Ban'ethil Barrow Den.

Situated off the highway between Dolanaar and Darnassus, Ban'ethil Hollow is a sharp reminder that the boughs of Teldrassil are not entirely safe. Furbolgs driven mad by the strange affliction plaguing the World Tree have taken refuge throughout the rocky descent. They frequently stalk the nearby path, waiting to ambush unwary couriers and wandering sentinels. Deep within the ravine sits the threshold of the Ban'ethil Barrow Den, where slumbering druids and ancient tunnels face encroachment from the maddened beasts outside.
